stories.title: Gender-critical equality officer unfairly sacked by council
stories.summary: Lorna Young was subjected to a "Kafkaesque" investigation into her social media posts, a judge rules.

stories.title: Wife drugged and raped by husband asked police if she was to blame, court hears
stories.summary: The woman told a court suggestions she was 'pretending to be asleep' were 'absolute rubbish'.

stories.title: GP who restarted Fabrice Muamba's heart struck off
stories.summary: A tribunal was told Jonathan Tobin had a secret, sexual relationship with a vulnerable patient.

stories.title: Boy died after choking in nursery days after birthday, inquest hears
stories.summary: Thiago Wall died in hospital three days after choking on food at the nursery, the inquest hears.

stories.title: Man charged with making explosives after street evacuation
stories.summary: Dozens of residents were forced to leave their homes in Droylsden for six days.

stories.title: Crash causes long rush-hour delays on M60
stories.summary: Two lanes are closed near the Trafford Centre, with queues stretching back onto the M62.

stories.title: John Stones faces trial over alleged motoring offence
stories.summary: The former Manchester City defender denies failing to provide driver information to police.

stories.title: Council's care service still needs improvement amid planned cuts
stories.summary: A report found signs of improvement but said it was "too early" to assess the long-term impact of the changes.

stories.title: Domestic abuse prevention orders a 'step in right direction'
stories.summary: Domestic abuse charity Endeavour welcomed the national rollout but said more work was needed.

stories.title: Substance released at concert could be linked to robberies, police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating a possible link between the Co-op Live evacuation and reported robberies.

stories.title: Restaurant boss banned over £363k furlough claims
stories.summary: The company received £363,040 but failed to provide evidence it was entitled to the money.

stories.title: Teen who fell from Benidorm balcony opens eyes after two weeks
stories.summary: Jamie, 17, has had two emergency operations since falling from a sixth-floor balcony on 10 November.
